predictions.prediction_text: Intraday we will continue to see upside realized vol while realized vol of vol is sold (RV selling), reinforcing weekly zomma supply.
predictions.expected_result: Measured intraday realized volatility rises on upside moves while higher-frequency realized vol-of-vol metrics (e.g., daily or intraday RV-of-RV) decline or show net selling flows.

predictions.prediction_text: CTAs will remain net buyers but will continue cutting until 6640/30 are broken.
predictions.expected_result: CTA net buying flows taper off and position adjustments continue; if price breaches 6640/30, CTA behavior shifts (increased selling or reduced buying).

predictions.prediction_text: Big players will act to produce intraday stability by dumping upside vol bets, causing upside vols to be sold down during intraday sessions.
predictions.expected_result: Intraday implied volatility on upside strikes or short-dated options decreases as dealers/large players sell upside vol, coinciding with realized upside moves being converted into sold options positions.
